learn.hook: Mangoes in summer, rain in the monsoon, sweaters in winter! India has many seasons.
points: We learn about five seasons: summer, rainy (monsoon), autumn, winter and spring.
Summer is hot. The rainy season brings lots of rain.
In autumn the weather turns pleasant and dry leaves fall. Winter is cold.
In spring, flowers bloom and new leaves grow.
Festivals come in different seasons: Holi in spring, Diwali in autumn, Lohri in winter.

example.q: Riya flies kites at Makar Sankranti in January. Which season is it?

learn.reallife: Summer vacation in May and June comes in the hottest part of the year.

quiz.q: Which season brings lots of rain?
quiz.explain: The monsoon is the rainy season in India.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the names of seasons

quiz.q: In which season do flowers bloom and new leaves grow?
quiz.explain: Spring is the season of new flowers and leaves.
quiz.mistake: Thinks flowers bloom most in winter

quiz.q: Holi is the festival of colours. In which season do we play Holi?
quiz.explain: Holi comes in March, in spring.
quiz.mistake: Does not link the festival to its season

quiz.q: Lohri is celebrated with a bonfire in January. Which season is it?
quiz.explain: January is cold, so it is winter. People sit around the warm fire.
quiz.mistake: Does not link January with winter

quiz.q: Kabir drinks lots of water and eats mangoes during his vacation. Which season is it?
quiz.explain: Mangoes and hot days mean summer.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up summer and rainy season

quiz.q: In which season does the weather turn pleasant and Diwali come?
quiz.explain: Diwali comes in October or November, in autumn.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the autumn season

teach.ask: Gappu: What are the seasons in India?
teach.praise: Wow! Summer, rainy, autumn, winter and spring. Each one is special!
teach.nudge: Which season is hot? Which one brings rain?

learn.hook: Mangoes, umbrellas and sweaters! Each one belongs to a season.
points: In summer it is hot. We drink cool water and eat mangoes.
In the rainy season it rains a lot. We use umbrellas and raincoats.
In winter it is cold. We wear sweaters.
A calendar shows the days, weeks and months of a year.
Most months have 30 or 31 days. February is the shortest month.

example.q: On a calendar, the 1st of the month is a Monday. What day is the 8th?
steps: So the 8th is also a Monday.

learn.reallife: We look at the calendar to find festivals, holidays and birthdays.

games.title: True or false?
items: Winter is cold, so we wear warm clothes.
A calendar shows the days and months.
It shows every day of every month.
We use umbrellas in the rainy season.
Umbrellas keep us dry in the rain.
If the 1st is a Monday, the 8th is a Monday too.
7 days later it is the same day again.
Summer is hot. Winter is the cold one.

quiz.q: In which season do we wear sweaters?
quiz.explain: Winter is cold. Sweaters keep us warm.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up hot and cold seasons

quiz.q: Aisha carries an umbrella and makes paper boats in puddles. Which season is it?
quiz.explain: Puddles and umbrellas mean lots of rain. It is the rainy season.
quiz.mistake: Does not use the clues in the story

quiz.q: On a calendar, the 1st is a Friday. What day is the 8th?
quiz.explain: The 8th is 7 days after the 1st. 7 days later is the same day: Friday.
steps: 7 days later is the same day
quiz.mistake: Moves on 1 day instead of 7 days

quiz.q: On a calendar, the 5th is a Tuesday. On which date is the next Tuesday?
quiz.explain: The next Tuesday is 7 days later. 5 + 7 = 12.
quiz.mistake: Adds 6 days instead of 7, or adds 1

quiz.q: Most months have how many days?
quiz.explain: Most months have 30 or 31 days. Only February has fewer.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up days in a month with days in a week or months in a year

quiz.q: Which month is the shortest?
quiz.explain: February has only 28 days, or 29 in a leap year. Other months have 30 or 31.
quiz.mistake: Thinks all months have the same number of days

teach.ask: Gappu: What do we wear and do in each season?
teach.praise: Lovely! Mangoes in summer, umbrellas in the rain, sweaters in winter!
teach.nudge: What happens in summer? In the rainy season? In winter?

learn.hook: Birthdays, Diwali and summer holidays! They all come in different months.
points: A year has 12 months.
January, February, March, April, May, June.
July, August, September, October, November, December.
January is the first month. December is the last month.
After December, a new year starts with January.

example.q: Which month comes just after March? Which comes just before March?
steps: The month after March is April.
The month before March is February.
example.answer: April comes after. February comes before.

learn.reallife: A calendar on the wall has one page for each of the 12 months.

quiz.q: How many months are there in a year?
quiz.explain: January to December makes 12 months.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up months in a year with days in a week

quiz.q: Which month comes just after June?
quiz.explain: The order is May, June, July. So July comes after June.
quiz.mistake: Gives the month before, or skips a month

quiz.q: Which is the first month of the year?
quiz.explain: Every year starts with January.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the first and the last month

quiz.q: Which month comes just before January?
quiz.explain: December is the last month. Then a new year starts with January.
quiz.mistake: Thinks nothing comes before January

quiz.q: Meena's birthday is in the 3rd month of the year. Which month is it?
quiz.explain: 1st January, 2nd February, 3rd March.
quiz.mistake: Counts from the wrong month

quiz.q: How many months come after September in the same year?
quiz.explain: After September come October, November and December. That is 3 months.
quiz.mistake: Counts September too

teach.ask: Gappu: How many months are in a year? Which one comes first?
teach.praise: Hooray! 12 months, and January comes first. December is last!
teach.nudge: How many months are there? What is the name of the first one?

topics.title: How many days in each month?

learn.hook: Do all months have the same number of days? Count on your knuckles!
points: Months have 30 or 31 days, except February.
30 days: April, June, September and November.
31 days: January, March, May, July, August, October and December.
February has 28 days, but 29 days in a leap year.
A leap year comes once in 4 years, like 2024 and 2028.

example.q: How many days are in July and in September?

learn.reallife: Knuckle trick: make two fists. Months on knuckles have 31 days. Months in the dips have fewer.

games.title: True or false?
items: February has 28 days, or 29 in a leap year
A leap year comes every year
July and August both have 31 days.

quiz.q: How many days are there in April?
quiz.explain: April is one of the 30-day months: April, June, September, November.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every month has 31 days

quiz.q: How many days are there in December?
quiz.explain: December has 31 days.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up 30-day and 31-day months

quiz.q: How many days does February have in a leap year?
quiz.explain: February has 28 days, and 1 more in a leap year: 29.
quiz.mistake: Forgets the extra day of a leap year

quiz.q: How often does a leap year come?
quiz.explain: A leap year comes once every 4 years.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every year is a leap year

quiz.q: 2024 was a leap year. Which year is the next leap year?
quiz.mistake: Adds 1 year instead of 4

quiz.q: Which of these months has 30 days?
quiz.explain: September is a 30-day month. The others have 31 days.
quiz.mistake: Does not remember the 30-day months

teach.ask: Gappu: Do all months have the same number of days?
teach.praise: Right! Most have 30 or 31, and February has 28 or 29.
teach.nudge: Which month is different from all the rest?

learn.hook: Sunday is fun day! But which day comes after it? Let's learn the 7 days.
points: A week has 7 days.
Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday.
After Saturday, a new week starts with Sunday.
Yesterday is the day before today. Tomorrow is the day after today.

example.q: Today is Wednesday. What day will it be tomorrow? What day was it yesterday?
steps: The day after Wednesday is Thursday.
The day before Wednesday is Tuesday.
example.answer: Tomorrow is Thursday. Yesterday was Tuesday.

learn.reallife: School days, the weekly market day and the Sunday holiday all follow the days of the week.

quiz.q: How many days are there in a week?
quiz.explain: Sunday to Saturday makes 7 days.
steps: Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat
quiz.mistake: Counts only the school days

quiz.q: Today is Thursday. What day is tomorrow?
quiz.explain: Tomorrow is the day after today. After Thursday comes Friday.
quiz.mistake: Gives the day before instead of the day after

quiz.q: Yesterday was Sunday. What day is today?
quiz.explain: Today is the day after yesterday. After Sunday comes Monday.
quiz.mistake: Goes back a day instead of forward

quiz.q: Arjun plays cricket every Saturday and Sunday. How many days does he play in 2 weeks?
quiz.explain: He plays 2 days each week. 2 weeks: 2 + 2 = 4 days.
quiz.mistake: Counts only one week

quiz.q: How many days are there in 2 weeks?
quiz.explain: Each week has 7 days. 7 + 7 = 14 days.
quiz.mistake: Adds 2 and 7, or writes 7 and 2 side by side

quiz.q: Kabir's birthday is 3 days after Monday. Which day is it?
quiz.explain: Count 3 days on from Monday: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday.
quiz.mistake: Counts Monday as one of the 3 days

teach.ask: Gappu: Today is Monday. What day is tomorrow? How do you know?
teach.praise: Yes! Tomorrow is the day after today. After Monday comes Tuesday!
teach.nudge: Does tomorrow come before today or after today?

learn.hook: How many Sundays this month? More Sundays, more fun!
points: Sundays in a month are 7 days apart, like 1, 8, 15, 22, 29.
Most months have 4 Sundays. Some have 5.
A 31-day month that starts on a Sunday has 5 Sundays.
Summer vacation is often in May and June. Winter vacation is in December or January.
To find the days in two months, add them: 30 + 31 = 61.

example.q: June starts on a Sunday. How many Sundays are in June?
steps: June has 30 days, so the 29th is in June.

learn.reallife: Families plan trips to visit relatives in the summer vacation.

items.text: A February of 28 days has ___ Sundays

quiz.q: The first Sunday of a 30-day month is the 2nd. What are the other Sundays?
quiz.explain: Add 7 each time: 2, 9, 16, 23, 30.
quiz.mistake: Adds 1 instead of 7

quiz.q: A month of 31 days starts on a Sunday. How many Sundays does it have?
quiz.explain: Sundays: 1, 8, 15, 22, 29. That is 5 Sundays.
quiz.mistake: Thinks every month has 4 Sundays

quiz.q: A February has 28 days. How many Sundays does it have?
quiz.explain: 28 days is exactly 4 weeks, so there are 4 Sundays.
quiz.mistake: Thinks it could have 5

quiz.q: In many schools, summer vacation is in which months?
quiz.explain: May and June are the hottest months, so schools close then.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up summer and winter vacation

quiz.q: June has 30 days and July has 31 days. How many days in both months?
quiz.mistake: Takes away instead of adding

quiz.q: A month starts on a Monday. On which date is the first Sunday?
quiz.explain: Mon 1, Tue 2, Wed 3, Thu 4, Fri 5, Sat 6, Sun 7.
quiz.mistake: Stops one day early

teach.ask: Gappu: How do I find all the Sundays in a month?
teach.praise: Yes! Find the first Sunday and keep adding 7.
teach.nudge: How many days apart are two Sundays?

learn.hook: Blink! That takes about a second. Sleeping at night takes hours!
points: Very quick things take seconds, like clapping or blinking.
Short jobs take minutes, like brushing your teeth.
Longer things take hours, like a school day or a film.
Very long things take days, like a long train trip across India.
We can compare which activity takes more time and which takes less.

example.q: Which takes longer: brushing your teeth or watching a cricket match?

learn.reallife: Cooking rice takes minutes, but growing rice in the field takes months!

quiz.q: How long does it take to clap once?
quiz.explain: A clap is very quick. It takes about a second.
quiz.mistake: Does not have a feel for a second

quiz.q: How long does it take to brush your teeth?
quiz.explain: Brushing takes about 2 or 3 minutes.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up minutes and hours

quiz.q: Which of these takes hours?
quiz.explain: A school day lasts many hours. The others take seconds.
quiz.mistake: Picks a very quick activity

quiz.q: Which takes longer: drinking a glass of milk or sleeping at night?
quiz.explain: Sleeping takes many hours. Drinking milk takes a minute or two.
quiz.mistake: Compares how tiring things are, not how long

quiz.q: Which of these can take days?
options: A long train trip across India
quiz.explain: A train trip across India can take 2 days.
quiz.mistake: Does not know how long a long journey takes

quiz.q: Which takes less time: sneezing or taking a bath?
quiz.explain: A sneeze takes a second. A bath takes minutes.
quiz.mistake: Picks the longer activity

teach.ask: Gappu: What takes seconds, and what takes hours?
teach.praise: Super! A blink takes seconds, and sleeping takes hours.
teach.nudge: Which quick things take seconds? Which long things take hours?

learn.hook: A trip to Dadi's house from 24 to 28 November. How many days away?
points: Count every day of the trip, the first day and the last day too.
24 to 28 November: 24, 25, 26, 27, 28 is 5 days.
For a day trip, count the hours from leaving to coming back: 8 o'clock to 2 o'clock is 6 hours.
When comparing two journeys, the one with more hours took longer.

example.q: A family leaves at 7 o'clock in the morning and returns at 1 o'clock in the afternoon. How long were they away?

learn.reallife: A train ticket shows when the train leaves and when it reaches.

items.q: 9 o'clock morning to 4 o'clock afternoon: hours

games.title: True or false?
items: A trip from 24 to 28 November lasts 5 days
A trip from 3 to 5 May lasts 2 days
Leaving at 9 o'clock and returning at 12 o'clock is 3 hours
A 10-hour train journey is shorter than a 6-hour one
Leaving at 8 o'clock for a 4-hour trip, you return at 12 o'clock

quiz.q: Asha stays with her Nani from 24 to 28 November. How many days is her trip?
quiz.explain: Count every day: 24, 25, 26, 27, 28. That is 5 days.
quiz.mistake: Takes away and forgets to count the first day

quiz.q: The school picnic leaves at 8 o'clock in the morning and returns at 2 o'clock. How many hours?
quiz.explain: 8 to 12 is 4 hours. 12 to 2 is 2 hours. 4 + 2 = 6.
quiz.mistake: Takes 2 from 8

quiz.q: A family leaves at 9 o'clock in the morning for a 5-hour trip. When do they get back?
quiz.explain: 9 to 12 is 3 hours. 2 more hours makes 2 o'clock.
quiz.mistake: Forgets that the clock starts again after 12

quiz.q: Train A takes 12 hours. Train B takes 9 hours. Which journey took longer?
quiz.explain: 12 hours is more than 9 hours.
quiz.mistake: Picks the smaller number

quiz.q: How many more hours did a 12-hour train journey take than a 9-hour one?
quiz.explain: 12 - 9 = 3 hours more.
quiz.mistake: Adds the two times

quiz.q: Vikram's trip is from 1 to 3 January. How many days is it?
quiz.explain: 1, 2, 3. That is 3 days.
quiz.mistake: Forgets to count the first day

teach.ask: Gappu: My trip is from 24 to 28 November. How many days is it?
teach.praise: Yes! Count every day, the first and last too: 5 days.
teach.nudge: Did I count the first day and the last day?

learn.hook: Tick-tock! A clock has two hands. Which one tells the hour?
points: A clock has a short hand and a long hand.
The short hand is the hour hand. The long hand is the minute hand.
When the long hand points to 12, it is o'clock. The short hand tells which hour.
We wake up at about 6 or 7 o'clock, go to school at about 8 o'clock and have lunch at about 1 o'clock.

example.q: The long hand is on 12 and the short hand is on 4. What time is it?

learn.reallife: The school bell rings at fixed times on the clock.

quiz.q: Which hand on a clock tells the hour?
quiz.explain: The short hand is the hour hand.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up the hour hand and the minute hand

quiz.q: The long hand is on 12 and the short hand is on 7. What time is it?
quiz.explain: Long hand on 12 means o'clock. The short hand shows 7.
quiz.mistake: Reads the long hand as the hour

quiz.q: The short hand is on 10 and the long hand is on 12. What time does the clock show?
quiz.explain: The short hand gives the hour: 10. Long hand on 12 means o'clock.
quiz.mistake: Reads the wrong hand

quiz.q: The long hand points to 12. What does that tell you?
quiz.explain: When the minute hand is on 12, the time is an exact hour, like 3 o'clock.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the long hand tells the hour

quiz.q: At about what time do many children eat lunch?
quiz.explain: Lunch is in the afternoon, at about 1 o'clock.
quiz.mistake: Does not link meal times to the clock

quiz.q: Which hand on a clock is the minute hand?
quiz.explain: The long hand is the minute hand.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the short hand is the minute hand

teach.ask: Gappu: How do I read 4 o'clock on a clock?
teach.praise: Yes! The long hand is on 12 and the short hand is on 4.
teach.nudge: Where does each hand point at 4 o'clock?

learn.hook: Can you set the clock hands for 5 o'clock? Be the clock maker!
points: To show an o'clock time, put the long hand on 12.
Then put the short hand on the hour number.
For 5 o'clock: long hand on 12, short hand on 5.
Show your own day on clocks: wake-up time, school time and bed time.

example.answer: Long hand on 12, short hand on 9

learn.reallife: We set an alarm clock for the time we want to wake up.

items.text: For 5 o'clock, the long hand points to ___
For 5 o'clock, the short hand points to ___
Short hand on 2, long hand on 12: ___ o'clock
For 11 o'clock, the short hand points to ___

games.title: True or false?
items: At 3 o'clock the long hand is on 12
At every o'clock time the long hand is on 12.
At 6 o'clock the short hand is on 12
Both hands point to 12 at 12 o'clock
The hour is 12 and it is o'clock.
At 8 o'clock the long hand points to 8
The long hand is on 12. The short hand is on 8.
To show 1 o'clock, put the short hand on 1
The short hand shows the hour.

quiz.q: The short hand is on 3 and the long hand is on 12. What time is it?
quiz.explain: The short hand shows the hour, 3.
quiz.mistake: Reads the long hand as the hour

quiz.q: To show 6 o'clock, where does the short hand go?
quiz.explain: The short hand points to the hour, 6.
quiz.mistake: Puts the short hand on 12

quiz.q: To show 6 o'clock, where does the long hand go?
quiz.explain: For any o'clock time the long hand points to 12.
quiz.mistake: Puts both hands on 6

quiz.q: Om wakes up at 6 o'clock. School starts 2 hours later. What time does school start?
quiz.explain: 6 + 2 = 8. School starts at 8 o'clock.
quiz.mistake: Takes away instead of adding

quiz.q: Both hands point to 12. What time is it?
quiz.explain: Short hand on 12 and long hand on 12 shows 12 o'clock.
quiz.mistake: Thinks the clock shows no time

quiz.q: Meera goes to bed at 9 o'clock. Where are the clock hands?
options: Short hand on 12, long hand on 9
Short hand on 9, long hand on 12
quiz.explain: The short hand shows the hour, 9. The long hand is on 12.
quiz.mistake: Swaps the two hands

teach.ask: Gappu: How do I set my clock to 5 o'clock?
teach.praise: Yes! Long hand on 12, short hand on 5.
teach.nudge: Where does the long hand go? And the short hand?

learn.hook: The sun rises in the east. Can you point to north, south, east and west?
points: There are four main directions: north, south, east and west.
The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
On a map, north is usually at the top, south at the bottom, east on the right and west on the left.
We can tell where things are: the well is east of the temple.
A route can go in one direction and then another: walk north, then turn east.

example.q: On a map, the school is north of the park. Where is the park from the school?
steps: If the school is north of the park, the park is south of the school.

learn.reallife: A compass needle always points to the north.

games.title: True or false?
items: The sun rises in the east
Every morning the sun comes up in the east.
On a map, south is usually at the top
North is usually at the top.
East and west face each other.
If the shop is north of the school, the school is south of the shop
There are 4: north, south, east and west.

quiz.q: In which direction does the sun rise?
quiz.explain: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up east and west

quiz.q: On a map, which direction is usually at the top?
quiz.explain: Maps usually show north at the top.
quiz.mistake: Thinks east is at the top

quiz.q: On a map, the well is to the right of the temple. In which direction is the well from the temple?
quiz.explain: On a map, right is east.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up left and right on a map

quiz.q: Which direction is opposite to east?
quiz.explain: East and west are opposites.
quiz.mistake: Thinks north is opposite to east

quiz.q: The library is north of Ravi's house. Where is Ravi's house from the library?
quiz.explain: North and south are opposites, so the house is south of the library.
quiz.mistake: Gives the same direction back

quiz.q: Tina walks north to the gate, then turns and walks east to the shop. In which direction did she walk last?
quiz.explain: First she went north, then east. The last part was east.
quiz.mistake: Gives the first direction of the route

teach.ask: Gappu: What are the four directions?
teach.praise: Yes! North, south, east and west. The sun rises in the east!
teach.nudge: Can you name all four? Where does the sun rise?
